Subject: SOC 2 Type II report access & trust artifacts — next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side related to compliance artifacts: 

1) What we can share today: attached is a short one-page summary of Redwood's current SOC 2 posture (SOC2_Summary_2027Q3.pdf) and a one‑pager on our attestation cadence.

2) Full report access: we can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report (for the period Nov 2026–May 2027) under a standard NDA / confidentiality path. If you prefer, we can also provide an interim attestation / bridge letter while the full report is routed via the Trust Portal.

3) Trust Portal access: to speed things up, we can provision an account for GreenSky's procurement group so you can download reports and artifact packages. If you can share the names / emails of anyone who should have view access (or confirm procurement@greenskyhealth.com is the right inbox), we’ll kick that off.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (DSQ/DDQ): send us the link or attach the questionnaire and we’ll have our security team respond within 3 business days for standard questionnaires. For custom procurement forms, please flag any required evidence or signed attestations up front.

5) HIPAA / KMS details: if HIPAA controls are a gating item, please let us know the specific fields you need (e.g., BAAs, data residency, key management details) and we’ll pull the relevant docs.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm whether you need the full Type II report vs. an interim bridge letter.
- Share the procurement contact(s) for Trust Portal access.
- Paste/attach the vendor questionnaire or share a link.

If you’re good with that, I’ll coordinate with security and Monica to provision portal access and get a bridge letter drafted for signature.

Best,
Ben

Thanks Ben — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from procurement/security here: 

- We require the full SOC 2 Type II PDF for our vendor risk team. We can accept a redacted version behind an NDA but would prefer the complete report if possible.
- A bridge letter/interim attestation will speed our review; please include the effective period and any carve-outs.
- HIPAA: we need confirmation that Redwood will sign a BAA and that keys are customer-isolated if we choose to bring PHI. Please call out KMS approach in the attestation or addendum.

Procurement would like timeline expectations. Can you get us the full report (or a redacted copy) and the bridge letter within 5 business days? If you need us to sign anything to enable portal access or to receive the full report, let us know and we'll expedite here.

Also sharing our procurement intake link here: https://procurement.greenskyhealth.com/vendor-intake (for your security team to complete)

Emma — thanks, noted and appreciate the procurement link. Quick answers and commitments: 

- Full report: we can provide a redacted PDF of the SOC 2 Type II report within 3 business days once a simple NDA is in place; a copy of the unredacted report requires the Trust Portal invite and a signed confidentiality agreement.
- Bridge letter: we will draft a bridge/interim attestation that includes the report period and any control exceptions and can deliver that within 2 business days. That will explicitly call out KMS approach and whether customer-managed keys are in scope.
- BAA/HIPAA: Redwood can execute a BAA for customers who bring PHI. I’ve looped Sean (security/compliance) and Monica (trust portal ops) to action.

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) I’ll send an NDA (DocuSign) to you this morning to enable the redacted report delivery.
2) Monica will provision a Trust Portal invite for procurement@greenskyhealth.com once we confirm the account contact.
3) Sean will start the KMS/BAA note and prepare the bridge letter draft.

Emma — can you confirm the primary portal user(s) (name + email) and whether procurement@greenskyhealth.com should be the default admin? If yes, we’ll provision that address and let you know when access is ready.

Thanks — will follow up after the NDA goes out.

Onward,
Ben
